phase_1_status: NOT READY — 8 blockers remaining after Phase 0
top_blockers: P0-CRITICAL: Research signals from browsing do NOT write to KnowledgeGraph — only explicit feedback does. The Research Card reads from KnowledgeGraph. So the card will always be EMPTY for new users who haven't manually liked/blocked topics.
P0-CRITICAL: Reddit platform is missing from IMPLICIT_SIGNAL platform union type — Reddit signals get cast to 'unknown' and lose platform attribution.

P0-CRITICAL: No end-to-end test of the cross-platform research trail (YouTube→Reddit→Amazon). The topic matching in injectResearchCardOnPDP uses naive word overlap on product title keywords vs graph entity names — likely produces zero matches for real products.
P0-CRITICAL: Web app dashboard is a placeholder — shows 'Research topics appear here once cloud sync is enabled' instead of actual research data.

P0-HIGH: Extension popup still builds and ships but manifest has no default_popup — popup code is dead weight. Overlay is the only UI, but its overlay toggle depends on content script being injected (fails on chrome://, about:, new tab).
P1-HIGH: Zero automated tests across the entire repository. No unit tests, no integration tests, no E2E tests.
P1-HIGH: Cloud backend tsc build fails with type errors (Hono context typing). Uses '|| true' workaround — JS emits but type safety is compromised.
P1-HIGH: No plans/pricing page exists anywhere. Billing routes exist in backend but UI is missing.
